item.title: N.C. 50 in Garner closed for nearly 3 months as part of bridge construction: NCDOT
item.description: A section of N.C. 50 in Garner will be closed for nearly three months as part of a project to construct a bridge in the area, the North Carolina Department of Transportation said.
